items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear fleet-wide go-live or security-sensitive releases. Evidence: security baseline generated 2026-09-30T16:50:07Z reports fleet-doctor not run with no findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across 61 sites; data quality is green/yellow but does not establish security controls. This is not evidence of compromise. Recommendation: maintain existing private and security-sensitive release gates; permit ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Complete the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Risk severity: high for unsupported public exposure or security-sensitive release; medium for monitoring and disclosure-readiness gaps. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions/configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
